jobs.title: QA Automation Analyst – Salesforce
jobs.description:
Location: Toronto, ON
Hybrid
Duration:1 year

QA Analyst-Test Automation

Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for Salesforce, API, web, and mobile applications.
Build and maintain regression, sanity, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and release validation testing.
Perform API testing and automation using tools such as Postman.
Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing into release processes.
Log, track, and validate defect resolutions using Jira and Agile delivery practices.
Contribute to the enhancement of automated test coverage using Provar, Appium, Selenium, and other testing tools.
Maintain test evidence, quality metrics, and release-readiness reports.

Required Skills

5+ years of QA and test automation experience.
Strong experience with Selenium, Provar, Appium, or similar automation frameworks.
Experience testing Salesforce applications and integrations
API testing experience using Postman.
Experience with CI/CD, Jira, Agile/Scrum, and defect management.
Knowledge of regression testing, release validation, and quality engineering best practices.

Preferred Skills

Provar for Salesforce test automation.
Appium mobile automation.
JMeter performance testing.
Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Marketing Cloud experience
